definition.question: How deadlocked are US-China diplomatic and summit-level channels?
definition.low_end: Regular leader summits, active working-level dialogue and functional crisis-management channels.
definition.high_end: Complete severance of high-level diplomacy with no leader summits, working-level dialogue or crisis-communication channels.

readings.rationale: Unassessed - evidence set contains no graded claims on summits, ministerial dialogue or crisis channels to ground a placement. Research needed: record of leader and ministerial meetings, working-group activity, and military/diplomatic hotline use. Would be higher with summit cancellations or dialogue suspensions; lower with announced summits or restored working-level talks.

Previously unassessed 2026-10-01 for lack of summit/dialogue evidence. New confirmed evidence shows full leader-level engagement: state visit Sep 23-25 2026 with tarmac greeting, White House state dinner, National Archives tour, truce extension to Jan 10 2027, new AI incident channel/Super Intelligence Dialogue with Nov 2026 follow-up, military MOU on crisis communication, and agreed next summits…

Closest to 2026-10-01 reading at 20 which already priced this state visit. New research replicates same evidence (tarmac greeting, Sep 23-25 visit, truce extension to Jan 10 2027, Bessent-He Sep 20 talks, Super Intelligence Dialogue, invitations to APEC Shenzhen/G20 Doral). AI notification channel remains undefined/not finalized and historical hotlines failed, confirming crisis-management not yet…
